이 안내는 명령을 실행할 수 없는 대화 창에서 써요. 아래 명령을 내 컴퓨터의 터미널에 붙여 넣어요. 계정·키·비용은 필요 없어요. 설치한 뒤에는 터미널을 닫았다 다시 열어요.

Use this guide in a chat window that cannot run commands. Paste the commands below into the terminal of your own computer. It needs no account, no key and no cost. After installing, close the terminal and open it again.

## 한국어

<a id="ko-windows"></a>

### Windows (PowerShell)

**1. Node.js**

Node.js 가 없거나 너무 낮아요. 사이트 도구가 Node.js 24.13.0 이상에서 돌아요.

```powershell
winget install --id OpenJS.NodeJS.LTS -e --source winget --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements
```

윈도우가 관리자 확인 창을 띄우면 「예」를 눌러요.

이 도구가 없으면: winget 이 없어요. nodejs.org/en/download 에서 LTS 설치 파일을 받아 실행해요.

성공하면: 새 터미널을 열고 `node --version` 을 쳐요. 24.13.0 이상 숫자가 나오면 돼요. npm 은 Node.js 와 함께 와요.

**2. Git**

git 이 없어요. 정해진 태그로 Sitebrew 를 내려받는 데 필요해요.

```powershell
winget install --id Git.Git -e --source winget --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements
```

윈도우가 관리자 확인 창을 띄우면 「예」를 눌러요.

이 도구가 없으면: winget 이 없어요. git-scm.com/download/win 에서 설치 파일을 받아 실행해요.

성공하면: 새 터미널을 열고 `git --version` 을 쳐요. 버전 숫자가 나오면 돼요.

**3. Chrome 또는 Edge**

Chrome 또는 Edge 를 찾지 못했어요. 품질 검사와 보드 사진에 필요해요.

```powershell
winget install --id Google.Chrome -e --source winget --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements
```

이 도구가 없으면: winget 이 없어요. google.com/chrome 에서 설치 파일을 받아요. Windows 11 에는 Edge 가 이미 있어요.

성공하면: 시작 메뉴에서 Chrome 이 열리면 돼요.

**4. Sitebrew 내려받기**

Sitebrew 폴더가 없어요. 고정 태그 v0.2.2 로 내려받아요. 현재 폴더 안에 sitebrew 폴더가 생겨요.

```powershell
git clone --branch v0.2.2 --depth 1 https://github.com/nowwcastle-sudo/sitebrew.git
```

성공하면: 현재 폴더 안에 `sitebrew` 폴더가 생겨요.

**5. Sitebrew 설치**

Sitebrew 의 패키지를 설치해요(npm run setup). 몇 분 걸리고 인터넷을 써요.

`sitebrew` 폴더 안에서 실행해요:

```powershell
cd sitebrew
npm.cmd run setup
```

성공하면: 오류 없이 끝나요. 처음에는 몇 분 걸려요. 빨간 오류 글이 보이면 그 글을 그대로 알려 줘요.

## English

<a id="en-windows"></a>

### Windows (PowerShell)

**1. Node.js**

Node.js is missing or too old. The site tools need Node.js 24.13.0 or newer.

```powershell
winget install --id OpenJS.NodeJS.LTS -e --source winget --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements
```

If Windows shows an administrator prompt, choose Yes.

If that tool is not available: winget is not available. Download the LTS installer from nodejs.org/en/download and run it.

When it works: Open a new terminal and type `node --version`. A number of 24.13.0 or higher means it worked. npm comes with Node.js.

**2. Git**

git is missing. It is needed to download Sitebrew at its pinned tag.

```powershell
winget install --id Git.Git -e --source winget --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements
```

If Windows shows an administrator prompt, choose Yes.

If that tool is not available: winget is not available. Download the installer from git-scm.com/download/win and run it.

When it works: Open a new terminal and type `git --version`. A version number means it worked.

**3. Chrome or Edge**

Chrome or Edge was not found. The quality checks and board photos need one.

```powershell
winget install --id Google.Chrome -e --source winget --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements
```

If that tool is not available: winget is not available. Download the installer from google.com/chrome. Windows 11 already ships Edge.

When it works: It worked if Chrome opens from the start menu or the applications folder.

**4. Download Sitebrew**

There is no Sitebrew folder. Download it at the pinned tag v0.2.2. A sitebrew folder is created in the current folder.

```powershell
git clone --branch v0.2.2 --depth 1 https://github.com/nowwcastle-sudo/sitebrew.git
```

When it works: A `sitebrew` folder appears in the current folder.

**5. Install Sitebrew**

Install the Sitebrew packages (npm run setup). It takes a few minutes and uses the internet.

Run it inside the `sitebrew` folder:

```powershell
cd sitebrew
npm.cmd run setup
```

When it works: It ends without an error. The first run takes a few minutes. If red error text appears, tell me that text as it is.

<a id="en-linux"></a>

### Linux (Terminal)

**1. Node.js**

Node.js is missing or too old. The site tools need Node.js 24.13.0 or newer.

```bash
nvm install 24.13.0
```

If you have nvm, paste this command into the terminal. Otherwise download from nodejs.org/en/download.

When it works: Open a new terminal and type `node --version`. A number of 24.13.0 or higher means it worked. npm comes with Node.js.

**2. Git**

git is missing. It is needed to download Sitebrew at its pinned tag.

```bash
sudo apt install git
```

This command may ask for the administrator password.

This needs the administrator password, so run it yourself. It is the Debian and Ubuntu command.

When it works: Open a new terminal and type `git --version`. A version number means it worked.

**3. Chrome or Edge**

Chrome or Edge was not found. The quality checks and board photos need one.

```bash
sudo apt install chromium
```

This command may ask for the administrator password.

This needs the administrator password, so run it yourself. The package name differs by distribution (chromium or chromium-browser).

When it works: It worked if Chrome opens from the start menu or the applications folder.

**4. Download Sitebrew**

There is no Sitebrew folder. Download it at the pinned tag v0.2.2. A sitebrew folder is created in the current folder.

```bash
git clone --branch v0.2.2 --depth 1 https://github.com/nowwcastle-sudo/sitebrew.git
```

When it works: A `sitebrew` folder appears in the current folder.

**5. Install Sitebrew**

Install the Sitebrew packages (npm run setup). It takes a few minutes and uses the internet.

Run it inside the `sitebrew` folder:

```bash
cd sitebrew
npm run setup
```

When it works: It ends without an error. The first run takes a few minutes. If red error text appears, tell me that text as it is.
